## About
Modderman Service is a Porsche specialist and a family business, now run by second-generation owner and technician David Modderman. Knowledge of these cars has been handed down from one generation to the next.
The shop moved from its longtime home on Old Middlefield Way to a larger building just down the road on Wyandotte Street in Mountain View. The extra room means more parking, a bigger garage and a spacious front office with a window looking into the work area.
The crew works with the latest tools, a dedicated Porsche scanner and current factory information, and uses high-quality factory parts. Clients come from across the South Bay, the East Bay and San Francisco.

## Services
- Brake service: Inspection of brake fluid, pads, rotors, wheel hubs and brake lines, with factory OEM parts used for replacements and upgraded pads available for track driving.
- Air conditioning service: Evacuating moisture, recharging the system and a visual inspection of the whole A/C system, plus leak repairs.
- Factory recommended services: The maintenance your Porsche's maker calls for, done by a shop that works on Porsches every day.
- Transmission rebuilding
- Wheel alignment

## FAQ
Q: Which Porsche models do you work on?
A: Any Porsche 911, 944 and 968, plus Boxster, Cayman, Cayenne and Panamera.

Q: How do I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: We offer a complimentary ride to your home or work within a 10-mile radius.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We only use high-quality factory parts on your car.
